text:
Two 3.0Ω resistors are connected in parallel.
Which statement about their combined resistance is correct?
The combined resistance is less than 3.0Ω.
A
The combined resistance is 3.0Ω.
B
The combined resistance is more than 3.0Ω but less than 6.0Ω.
C
The combined resistance is 6.0Ω.
D

options.label: A
options.text: The combined resistance is less than 3.0Ω.

options.label: C
options.text: The combined resistance is more than 3.0Ω but less than 6.0Ω.
